# Astra
This skill is meant to look like Amazon Astro's UI, mimicking certain elements like the eye.

On the store page, this README file will appear when you click on a theme/skill allowing you to read more about it. The first small part of the nonheader README will be displayed underneath the title of the theme/skill, though it will only support 2 lines of it. That would mean the short description of Astra seen under the name would be something like:
This skill is meant to look like Amazon Astro's UI, mimicking certain elements like the eye.
As that was the first nonheader line of Astra, but it wasn't long enough to be elipsized
